I can't cover this, so I'm declaring bankruptcy. I owe $1,100 rent and have $84. Everything I could still sell or mortgage adds up to about $555:
- Mortgaging St. James, Tennessee, Water Works and Short Line would raise $355.
- Selling all 8 houses at half price would raise $200.

That gets me to roughly $639 at most, which is still about $460 short. Selling off assets now would only delay the loss.
